gitCommit.subject: Add Sprint 1 and Sprint 2 suites for Nyle's build with a GitHub Actions workflow [skip ci]
gitCommit.body:
Add Sprint 1 and Sprint 2 suites for Nyle's build with a GitHub Actions workflow [skip ci]

- sprint1/: TC-01..TC-14 ported to Nyle's Python build (routes, labels, CSV headers)
- sprint2/: TC-15..TC-27 updated for the new Add Violation form and Log Contact screen
- .github/workflows/sprint-tests.yml: runs both suites (manual or on test changes)
  and commits results to results/sprint1 and results/sprint2
- scripts/summarize.mjs: builds SUMMARY.md from the JSON results

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
